subject: Vendor onboarding kickoff: security pack & PO prerequisites
messages:
From: Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@acme-corp.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: ProcureOps Team <procureops@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding for Redwood — security evidence and PO steps

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the demo last week — Acme is excited to move toward a pilot. Procurement asked me to start the vendor setup so we can issue a PO once the contract is finalized. Can you please send the standard onboarding checklist and the security/compliance artifacts your procurement team requires? In particular ProcureOps needs:

- SOC 2 Type II report (or SOC 2 letter if full report is restricted)
- ISO 27001 certificate
- Penetration test executive summary or attestation
- Vendor onboarding form (W-9 / Tax ID and bank details can come later)

If there are any templates or a single zip of documents, that would be ideal. We’re aiming to have a PO requested by next Wednesday (2026-03-10).

Best,
Jenna Ortiz
Senior Procurement Manager | Acme Corp
procurement@acme-corp.com

---
Acme Corp — Procurement Hotline: +1 555-0123
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Cc: ProcureOps Team <procureops@acme-corp.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding for Redwood — security evidence and PO steps

Hi Jenna,

Thanks — happy to get this moving. Attached is a first pass of the security pack we usually provide to enterprise procurement teams: a redacted SOC 2 Type II report, our ISO 27001 certificate, and the pen test executive summary. I also filled the vendor onboarding form with our legal entity and bank stub (attached).

A couple notes:
- The SOC 2 full report contains customer-sensitive detail; we typically provide a redacted PDF or execute an NDA for the full report. If Acme needs the unredacted copy we can route through Legal.
- Pen test summary is high-level; we can provide more detail to your security team on a call.
- Tax/W-9 is available on request (US entities) — I’ve attached a vendor_onboarding_form_filled.pdf with a placeholder for bank account; Finance prefers to exchange bank details via the secure vendor portal.

I’m copying Rishi (SE) to offer a short security Q&A if your team wants it. Next steps we suggest: 1) confirm that the attached pack meets ProcureOps minimums, 2) send any additional evidence requests, 3) we’ll hand off to Legal for contract redlines.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025_redacted.pdf (PDF, 2.1 MB), ISO27001-Certificate_2025.pdf (PDF, 260 KB), PenTest-Letter-ExecutiveSummary.pdf (PDF, 420 KB), vendor_onboarding_form_filled.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: internal: Acme procurement — what to redact and what to share

Team,

Saw Monica’s outbound — quick internal checklist before we send anything more to Acme Legal:

- SOC 2: confirm the redactions removed customer-specific test work and any internal control evidence linked to other customers. If Acme requests the full SOC 2, Legal should execute a limited-scope NDA.
- Pen test: the executive summary is fine for Procurement. If security wants the full report, we route through InfoSec for disclosure controls.
- ISO certificate: fine to share publicly — include the registrar name and issue/expiry dates.
- Vendor form: do NOT include full bank account numbers in an attachment. Point them to the vendor portal URL once PO is confirmed.

Also: pricing is still under the NDA-free quote we provided. If Procurement asks for a redline or PO-dependent discount, let Sales Ops handle the approval path.

I’ll be available to join the Q&A with Acme Security tomorrow at 9:00 PT if needed.

-Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@acme-corp.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: ProcureOps Team <procureops@acme-corp.com>, Acme Legal <legal@acme-corp.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 08:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding for Redwood — security evidence and PO steps

Hi Monica,

Thank you for the quick turnaround and the attachments — I passed them to Procurement and Legal. A couple of follow-ups from our side:

- Legal would like confirmation that the redacted SOC 2 covers the period Jan–Dec 2025 and that Redwood’s control environment is unchanged since the report date. Can you confirm?
- ProcureOps flagged the vendor_onboarding_form_filled.pdf: please replace the bank placeholder with instructions to add bank details via our vendor portal (we cannot accept attachments with full bank details).
- Legal would like a pen-test attestation letter addressed to Acme for their audit file if possible (one-page attestation signed by InfoSec).

If you can confirm the SOC 2 period and provide the attestation, we can move to the PO issuance step. We’ll also send a DocuSign PO link once Legal signs off internally.

Regards,
Jenna Ortiz
Senior Procurement Manager | Acme Corp
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Ortiz <jenna.ortiz@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding for Redwood — security evidence and PO steps

Hi Jenna — great, thanks for the clear feedback. Answers and next steps below:

1) SOC 2 period: confirmed — the redacted SOC 2 covers audit period Jan 1, 2025 through Dec 31, 2025. Control environment unchanged in material ways since report issuance. We’ll provide a short confirmation statement from our Compliance team.

2) Vendor form: I updated the vendor_onboarding_form_filled.pdf to remove the placeholder bank section and replaced it with: "Please submit bank account details securely via Acme Vendor Portal: https://vendors.acme-corp.com". I’ve re-attached the corrected PDF to the DocuSign package below.

3) Pen-test attestation: attaching a one-page signed attestation from our InfoSec lead (PenTest-Letter-ExecutiveSummary.pdf includes the attestation page). If Acme Legal needs the full report, please request it and we’ll route it through InfoSec + Legal under NDA.

4) DocuSign PO: once Legal confirms, please send the DocuSign PO link. For accounting, please include the Redwood vendor ID: RW-00458 in the PO notes.

Related links: DocuSign PO draft: https://www.docusign.com/sign?envelopeId=ABC123-PO-ACME; Security pack folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBqSecurityPack

Attachments (updated): Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025_redacted.pdf, ISO27001-Certificate_2025.pdf, PenTest-Letter-ExecutiveSummary.pdf, vendor_onboarding_form_filled.pdf

If Legal wants to jump on a 20-minute call to close the evidence checklist, Rishi and I are available tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
